title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: THE POSSUM SUIT
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Tonya Fontenot, a baggage handler in Lafayette, Louisiana.
She lifts suitcases all day, and she has never danced in front of a living soul.
Then somebody handed her a possum suit.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE SUIT
segments.quote: Be bold and mighty forces will come to your aid.
segments.author: Basil King
lines: Her cousin Darnell runs the Bayou Possums, the town's minor league baseball team.
Their mascot, Percy the Possum, quit in June. The suit only fit Tonya.
She said no three times. Then she saw a line on his office door, from the writer Basil King:
Be bold and mighty forces will come to your aid.
She zipped up. The mighty forces turned out to be two box fans.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: STIFF AS A BAT
segments.quote: Keep the juices flowing by jangling around gently as you move.
segments.author: Satchel Paige
lines: Her first night, she waved like a stop sign. Nobody cheered.
Mr. Clement, an old usher, leaned over and quoted the pitching legend Satchel Paige:
Keep the juices flowing by jangling around gently as you move.
So she jangled. Hips, tail, elbows. The whole section jangled back.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: THE TAIL
segments.quote: There is nothing in the world so irresistibly contagious as laughter and good-humour.
segments.author: Charles Dickens
lines: In the seventh inning, she tripped on her own tail and landed flat on the dugout roof.
Five thousand people laughed. Inside the possum head, her face burned.
Then she remembered Charles Dickens:
There is nothing in the world so irresistibly contagious as laughter and good-humour.
So she lay there and laughed with them. Now Percy plays dead every seventh inning, on purpose.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: THE HECKLER
segments.quote: I will permit no man to narrow and degrade my soul by making me hate him.
segments.author: Booker T. Washington
lines: One man in a crawfish hat booed Percy every single game.
Tonya wanted to dump his nachos down his shirt.
Then she thought of the teacher Booker T. Washington:
I will permit no man to narrow and degrade my soul by making me hate him.
So she brought him a foam finger. By August, he was booing the other team.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: THE OFFER
segments.quote: Find out what you like doing best and get someone to pay you for doing it.
segments.author: Katharine Whitehorn
lines: Darnell asked her to stay all season. Tonya said she'd do it for free.
Mr. Clement quoted the British columnist Katharine Whitehorn:
Find out what you like doing best and get someone to pay you for doing it.
So Tonya named a fair price. Darnell paid it, plus free nachos.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE LAST GAME
segments.quote: How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
segments.author: Annie Dillard
lines: On the last night, she pulled off the head, and the crowd finally saw Percy's face.
Her airport crew held a sign in the front row. Tonya, we knew it.
She thought of the writer Annie Dillard:
How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
Now she jangles a little at the baggage belt, too.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Be bold. Loosen up. Laugh. Don't hate. Get paid. Spend your days well.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Be bold. Loosen up. Laugh at your falls. Don't hate. Get paid for your joy. Spend your days well.
I wore a mascot suit once. Everyone said it was my best look.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
